finding.scope: Real local ingress and auth/document routers, synthetic sessions and document list port. Distinct clients collapse into one socket bucket by default; forwarding-header changes cannot bypass it. Not live stress or real OAuth.

implementation: Default TCP/API configuration remains socket-based and ignores supplied client identity claims. No compose default changed.
Opt-in ingress uses a protected Unix socket and a key file. It signs only when actually bound to the configured socket; a TCP-bound trusted factory returns503 and never signs.
Only one valid CF client IP claim is accepted on the protected path. Inherited proof is removed and replaced; proof is removed from upstream responses.

Root/current UID directory ownership is checked through all ancestors; unsafe nonsticky writable ancestors, symlinks, existing files/sockets and incorrect parent permissions are refused. No existing object is deleted or repaired. Socket permissions0600, private parent0700.
Opaque stable HMAC bucket ID is separated from the proof domain. Proof binds version, HTTPS origin, timestamp, bucket, method and exact raw URL; age30s/future5s limits and timing-safe MAC check.

Explicit API opt-in rejects missing/duplicate/invalid proof with403 instead of socket fallback. Proof selects a bucket only; session, ownership, CSRF and document validation remain mandatory. Replaying proof consumes the same bucket.

Local Worker candidate rebuilds XRealIP from its first validated CF client value and removes inherited proof/forwarding claims on both normal origin requests and broken-config origin fallback. Worker limit fail-open configuration stays unchanged.
